name: Azy Agent
welcome: Ask about Azy Board or ask for help with a task.
adjustPlaceholder: Describe what should change before approval...
pasteHint: Text and CSV can be pasted
runFailed: The run failed. You can try again.
rateLimit: Too many messages in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
concurrencyLimit: An agent run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish before sending another.
quotaExceeded: Daily agent budget reached. Try again tomorrow.
assistantUnavailable: The agent is not enabled for this tenant. Configure the provider in settings.
completedWithoutMessage: The run completed without an additional message.
messageTooLong: The message is too large. Reduce or split it to at most 30,000 bytes.
actionLimit: This request requires too many actions for one run. Split it into batches of at most 40 actions.
repeatedToolCall: The agent repeated a query and could not finish. Try again.
availabilityHelp: Available only with a validated provider.
oauthUnsupported: OAuth/token plan is not compatible with the model API in this environment.
securityNote: Credentials are never displayed or sent to the browser.
